xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes :

1) The Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of the Group for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards (“Ind AS”) as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 and relevant amendment rules thereafter.

2) The Unaudited Consolidated Financial Result of the Group for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and thereafter approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 27th October, 2026. The Statutory Auditors have carried out a limited review of these results.

3) Cost towards Development of Property amounting to Rs. 2,650.99 Lakhs is for Holding Company's one-off residential property development project at Dombivali,Thane, Maharashtra and corresponding amount is disclosed in "Changes in Inventories of Finished Goods, Stock in Trade, Work-in-Progress and Property under Development".

4) Pursuant to the Scheme of 9% Cumulative Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares (NCRPS) approved by National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai, the Holding Company has alloted NCRPS to its equity shareholders as Bonus on 25th August 2026. Consequent to the aforesaid allotment :-

a) The General Reserve amounting to Rs. 31,759.06 lakhs has been utilised towards the issuance of the NCRPS. In accordance with the applicable requirements of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), the NCRPS have been classified and presented under the head “Non-Current Borrowings” in the standalone financial results.

b) A provision of Rs. 289.15 lakhs has been recognised towards the 9% cumulative dividend payable on the NCRPS for the period from the date of allotment up to 30th September,2026. In accordance with the applicable requirements of Ind AS, the amount has been recognised as “Finance Costs” in the standalone financial results.

c) The NCRPS will be listed on the NSE and BSE (the stock exchange on which the Company’s equity shares are listed). The necessary application in this regard has been made to both the stock exchanges on 30th September 2026.

5) The Board of Directors of the Holding Company has declared an Interim dividend of Rs. 4/- (200%) per equity share of Rs. 2 each. The cash outgo on account of Interim dividend will be Rs. 1,814.80 Lakhs.

6) The Group is engaged mainly in Textile business and there are no other reportable segments as per Ind AS 108.

7) The previous period's/year's figures have been regrouped/rearranged wherever necessary.
